nodes.description: Mapping address => uint256 tracking ETH credited balances per account.
Nested mapping [owner][token] => uint256 tracking deposited ERC20 balances per account.
Public view that loops over a multi-token contract and accumulates token weights with unchecked addition.
Public view returning an array of token balances for an account across a list of tokens.
Payable external function crediting ETH and pulling ERC20 tokens from msg.sender into the contract before updating balances.
Internal function that transfers ETH and ERC20 tokens out to a recipient before decrementing caller balances.
External wrapper delegating to withdrawInternal.
External function computing full caller balances then delegating to withdrawInternal.
Internal function performing an arbitrary value-bearing external call to an exchange after blacklist-checking the calldata selector, then updating balances.
Internal function approving tokens to a multi-token contract and minting shares, updating tokenBalances afterwards.
Payable function executing up to ten sequential buyInternal calls with early returns based on token array length.
Payable function invoking buy10 and then mintInternal against a multi-token.
Payable function crediting msg.value and performing a single buyInternal call.
Caller-controlled address used for balance ownership and token transfer origin.
External ERC20 transferFrom call pulling tokens from msg.sender before the recipient balance is updated.
Arbitrary low-level value-bearing external call forwarding attacker-supplied calldata to an arbitrary address.
External call minting multi-token shares to msg.sender after approvals.
External ERC20 approve call granting the multi-token contract an allowance over contract-held tokens.
ETH transfer to a caller-supplied address executed before the caller balance is decremented.
External ERC20 transfer to a caller-supplied address executed before tokenBalances are decremented.
Parameter of deposit naming the account credited in balances and tokenBalances.
Parameter of deposit listing the ERC20 token addresses to pull in.
Parameter of deposit listing the ERC20 amounts to pull in, indexed parallel to _tokens.
Parameter of withdrawInternal naming the ETH/ERC20 recipient.
Parameter of withdrawInternal giving the amount of ETH to send out.
Parameter of buyInternal giving the arbitrary external callee address.
Parameter of buyInternal giving raw calldata forwarded to the exchange call.
Parameter of mintInternal giving the multi-token contract to approve and mint against.
Local ERC20 handle created inside the deposit loop from _tokens[i].
Local memory array built in allBalances holding per-token balances of an account.
Local accumulator in sumWeightOfMultiToken incremented with unchecked addition.
Local variable in mintInternal initialized to uint256(-1) and minimized across tokens before minting.

edges.reason: deposit invokes the external ERC20 transferFrom on the caller-supplied token address.
tokenBalances is only credited after the external transferFrom call, so re-entry can observe stale balances.
buyInternal performs the arbitrary external value-bearing call.
The caller balance is debited only after the external exchange call returns.
The token balance is credited only after the external exchange call returns.
mintInternal makes external approve calls that hand allowance to the multi-token contract.
mintInternal calls the external mint on the multi-token contract.
tokenBalances is only reconciled after the external mint call completes.
withdrawInternal sends ETH to a caller-supplied address inside the call flow.
The ETH balance is decremented after the transfer, allowing re-entrant withdrawal of the same funds.
withdrawInternal makes external ERC20 transfers to a caller-supplied address.
tokenBalances is decremented only after the external ERC20 transfer succeeds.
withdraw delegates all logic to withdrawInternal.
withdrawAll delegates all logic to withdrawInternal.
withdrawAll reads per-token balances through allBalances.
buy10 issues up to ten sequential buyInternal calls.
buy10mint first executes buy10.
buy10mint then executes mintInternal.
buyOne performs a single buyInternal call.
msg.sender is passed as the transferFrom origin in deposit.
msg.sender indexes the balances mapping that is credited and debited.
msg.sender indexes the tokenBalances mapping in buy and mint paths.
msg.sender determines whose balance withdrawInternal decrements.
sumWeightOfMultiToken accumulates weights with unchecked addition, which can overflow.
allBalances writes per-token balances into the tokenValues array before returning it.
deposit instantiates the token local from the caller-supplied token list.
buyInternal forwards value and calldata to the caller-supplied exchange address.
mintInternal reduces bestAmount across all multi-token constituent tokens before minting.

normalization_plan.reason: _beneficiary is a deposit parameter used directly to key the balance mappings credited by deposit.
_tokens_deposit is a deposit parameter iterated to select the ERC20 contracts pulled in by deposit.
_tokenValues_deposit is a deposit parameter supplying the amounts transferred in by deposit.
_to is a withdrawInternal parameter naming the recipient of the outgoing transfers.
_value is a withdrawInternal parameter controlling the ETH amount sent out.
_exchange is a buyInternal parameter used as the arbitrary external call target.
_data is a buyInternal parameter forwarded verbatim as external calldata.
_mtkn is a mintInternal parameter used for the approve and mint external calls.
token_deposit is the local ERC20 handle on which transferFrom is invoked inside deposit.
tokenValues is the local array populated and returned by allBalances.
sumWeight is the local accumulator whose unchecked addition belongs to sumWeightOfMultiToken.
bestAmount is the local value computed and passed to the external mint call in mintInternal.
